output: propulsion kWh; add (base + ePTO + HVAC) kW * hours for total energy

architecture.combine: mean of members, floored at zero

training.driver_flags: profile_eco and profile_normal; Aggressive is both at zero
training.split: by route_id; no route appears in two splits

linear_check.description: no-hidden-layer network vs least squares on the same network inputs

assumptions: Labels come from the Model F physics simulator, not real Isuzu trips.
Inputs are computed from a simulated speed trace; they are not known before a trip.
Base electronics, ePTO, and HVAC are added as kW times hours after propulsion.
